title: A profile of Jensen Huang, whom longtime friends and associates say has an unrelenting ability to make the most of any situation, as he returns as Nvidia's CEO (Erich Schwartzel/Wall Street Journal)
summary: Erich Schwartzel / Wall Street Journal: A profile of Jensen Huang, whom longtime friends and associates say has an unrelenting ability to make the most of any situation, as he returns as Nvidia's CEO — As a longtime friend of the Nvidia CEO puts it, “Jensen will always pull a rabbit out of a hat”
